Role: Java Backend Developer
Requirements:
- B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science or Information Technology
- At least 3 years of enterprise software development experience
- Must have solid hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Microservices, and MySQL
- Strong knowledge of Object Oriented Programming and Design Patterns
Nice to have:
- Experience with Kafka, Docker, and AWS is a plus
- Knowledge of Redis caching and Kubernetes is desirable
